base_currency_commission: quantity adjustment; marks net-after-cost completed-unit outcome ambiguous unless all commissions are settlement currency
position_realized_pnl: accumulates trading PnL, settlement-currency commissions, and PositionAdjusted.pnl_change
position_realized_return: native price return for the Position cycle

terminal_unrealized_pnl: not part of a completed Position unit
